To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) A simple recurrent neural network with a gated input can achieve competitive performance on the word-level Penn Treebank language modeling task.
1. A simple, non-chaotic RNN architecture performs comparably to more complex RNNs.

(i) we propose a simple recurrent neural network that achieves competitive performance on the word-level Penn Treebank language modeling task, (ii) we provide an analysis that explains the performance of the network in terms of its underlying dynamical system, and (iii) we prove that the underlying dynamical system is non-chaotic.
In summary, our research is concerned with
two main contributions: 1) a novel, simple RNN architecture, and 2) a novel approach to understanding the underlying dynamics of neural network-based models.

the following questions: What is the minimal recurrent neural network that achieves competitive performance on word-level language modeling tasks? What are the dynamics underlying the minimal RNN? Can the dynamics be made predictable and non-chaos?
the question: what is the simplest possible RNN that can be used for word-level language modeling?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

we present a new gated recurrent neural network, which is simple and has a well-defined and predictable dynamics, and which achieves performance comparable to the best gated recurrent neural networks on the word-level Penn Treebank language modeling task.
the proposed architecture has a simple and predictable dynamics, and it is competitive in terms of performance to other architectures, while being simpler and easier to train.
we introduce a simple recurrent neural network with predictable dynamics that achieves comparable performance to more complicated architectures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have introduced an exceptionally simple RNN that is as powerful as the more complex RNNs.
we have introduced a simple, non-chaotic RNN that achieves performance comparable with well-known chaotic models.
the RNN without chaos is a simple and powerful model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
chaotic dynamics are not a necessity for good RNN performance.
it is not necessary to resort to complex dynamical systems in order to achieve state-of-the-art performance on language modeling tasks.
recurrent neural networks can achieve competitive performance without chaos.
